purpose: Evaluate transfer of two completed SW0134 seed1 16-grid models to registered native32 inference without training.

input.source: same-seed SW0097 checkpoint spatially mapped by frozen SW0135 native32 mapping
input.rgb: registered native128 RGB cache encoded by transferred SW0134 encoder; no cached16 gamma

transfer.wrapped_state: strictly split core.* and exactly a_d,a_m,b; map and strict-load all core tensors, preserve all integration tensors
transfer.binder: strict-load complete SW0134 binder including persistent initial_noise buffer

readouts.primary: native32 learned P argmax with SW0135 canonical largest-slot background/tie readout
readouts.secondary: native32 actual-spike QCC, threshold .50, min group 8, largest-component background
readouts.source_reference: same-seed mapped SW0097 native32 QCC, generated alongside actual_joint without GT

evaluation.gt: modal/minimum-ID-tie 4x4 native pixel pooling using production evaluator
evaluation.ordering: All prediction NPZs/protocols, image IDs, and hashes are frozen and rechecked before reading any GT mask.

slot32_reference.source: existing three-seed SW0092 70k native128 predictions pooled directly by 4x4

interpretation: Two-arm, one-seed transfer screen only. Does not establish native32 training benefit, three-seed success, gate necessity, scaling, or promotion. No checkpoint selection or automatic training extension.
